items.titolo: Nvidia’s Open Source Alliance Is Missing Some Key Names: OpenAI and Anthropic
items.descrizione: This week on Uncanny Valley, we discuss the open- vs. closed-source debate in AI, key players in White House AI policy, and how to stop your chatbot logs from showing up in search-engine results.
